usageNotes: Permanently removes a named IP/network alias from the cluster-level firewall configuration. The alias must not be actively referenced by any firewall rules or IPSets before deletion; removing a referenced alias can silently break rule resolution. Use the `digest` parameter when scripting concurrent workflows to guard against race conditions overwriting an in-flight configuration change.

examples.summary: Delete the alias 'mgmt-net' from cluster firewall aliases

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the named alias from the cluster firewall; any firewall rules or IPSets that reference it by name will silently lose their target, potentially allowing or blocking unintended traffic.
tips: Fetch the current digest via GET /cluster/firewall/aliases/{name} and pass it here to prevent clobbering concurrent edits.
Search all cluster and node firewall rules for references to the alias name before deletion — Proxmox does not enforce referential integrity on aliases.
Returns null (HTTP 200) on success; no UPID is issued since this is a synchronous configuration change, not an async task.
